articles.title: Poland Arrests Alleged Spy Working for Russia in Defense Ministry
articles.mainIdea: Poland Arrests Alleged Spy Working for Russia in Defense Ministry
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Poland Arrests Alleged Spy Working for Russia in Defense Ministry. WARSAW—Polish authorities arrested a Defense Ministry official Tuesday for allegedly spying on behalf of Russia and Belarus, officials said, in one of the highest-profile espionage cases to come to light inside the Polish government. The accused 60-year-old official worked in the ministry’s division of strategy and planning, a ministry official familiar with the case said. It was unclear how he had allegedly aided Russia’s and Belarus’s intelligence agencies, which have carried out a string of hybrid warfare and sabotage activities on Polish soil since the start of the Ukraine war.
